overview: Britain's best (and worst) variety acts compete to win a spot at the Royal Variety Show.

seasons.name: Season 9
seasons.overview: "Britain's Got Talent" is a reality talent show hosted by Ant and Dec. Any sort of entertainment act is able to enter the competition and hopefully impress the judges and make it through to the final stages of the competition. The series winner's prize is £100,000 and the chance to perform at the "Royal Variety Show". The judges on the show are Simon Cowell, Piers Morgan and Amanda Holden.
